A_generic_usage.description: G20 generic-usage guard: lowercase surface of a capitalised registry name in a verb/adjective frame; no alias metadata

B_ambiguous_alias_cue.description: reviewed ambiguity metadata (7 aliases) + positive technical cue required for those only

G_go_cue.description: cue-gated recognition of capitalised 'Go' (lead-in / head noun / registry list sibling)

BG_context_aware.description: Option B as specified: context-aware alias recognition = B + G

C_unresolved_validation.description: unresolved-fragment validation (abstract-noun / non-technical fragment gate + claim-initial discourse adverb), registry recognition untouched

Q_equivalence.description: alias equivalence: an OR whose every segment resolves to one registry concept -> one row

DB_combined_with_metadata.description: C + Q + B (with the reviewed ambiguity metadata)

E_clause_scope_STUDY.description: STUDY ONLY: concepts only from G21 qualification units (clause-level; out of G22 scope)

POSTHOC_B2.description: POST-HOC: B + head nouns knowledge/expertise + capitalised-sibling cue

POSTHOC_C2.description: POST-HOC: C, adverb gate skipped for a pure list of single capitalised tokens

post_hoc_policies.caveat: written AFTER the EVAL run to address measured recall costs; DEV, EVAL and G21 negation-scope informed them, so their numbers are NOT validation

labels.eval: authored separately before the policy design freeze by the SAME researcher: weakly held out, not independent validation
